summary: Multi-symbol volume-anomaly scanner. For each candidate, computes volume z-score versus rolling baseline, price alignment (EMA), and structural breakout context, then ranks by composite score.
core_logic: For each candidate symbol, compute rolling volume mean and z-score over the lookback window.
Compute price alignment via EMA20 vs EMA50 stance.
Compute breakout signal: latest close vs rolling N-bar high.
Aggregate volume / alignment / breakout into a 0-100 composite score.
Rank symbols, tag verdict (STRONG_CANDIDATE / CANDIDATE / WATCHLIST / SKIP / AVOID).
recommended_next_step: Top STRONG_CANDIDATE symbols feed into structured-trade-plan or three-tier-strategy.
